title: Mountain Bike: carve like Bottomless (your pick, tuned)
kaylee: Your feel-lab numbers are in: a gentler carve (39°), almost twice the speed (14.8 m/s) and the camera swung further behind her. Hops off the blue way's rocks now follow the bend instead of landing her in the island.
questions: Ready for her iPad, or another round on the feel (ready or tune)?

pictures.title: Same pushes, before and after (0.6 s a frame)
pictures.caption: Before, the bike drifted toward a spot and the camera stayed on the trail. Now it carves across, Maple leans hard into it and the camera swings behind her.
